text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—I went ahead and sent that outfit
to the dry cleaner's for you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She should be back shortly...
Once she is... just to be safe, I'll try it on
to make sure there are no issues...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe's new outfit――
an attire tailored perfectly for her, suiting her so well.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I really like it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...What do you think, Trainer?
Um... do you think that outfit suits me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even looking back now, I can say with certainty that it suited her well. However—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...In what way?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Elegant, beautiful, composed, and then... so many words came to mind that, ironically, I could only manage a rather vague impression.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Thank you very much.
............Fufufu.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm not explaining this very well...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No.
...I understand. It is alright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while later, the outfit returned from the cleaners.
To make sure there were no issues, she changed into it, but...
choice_data_list: Shall we take some photos somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...A photo, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This is also a special racing outfit.
It would be a waste to wear it
just to check for problems."
choice_data_list: It should be a place that matches the outfit, so... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(...They're thinking about it.
For my sake...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Sunset will be here soon...
Maybe a haunted house, or some ruins...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"What a gorgeous outfit.
It looks like something that would
belong in a mysterious castle...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That's what they call 'alluring,' huh.
I don't know how to put it, but there's this quiet intensity to it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone told me that
a place like that suits me...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(............
As long as Trainer chooses it for me...
either one is fine with me, though.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ! ...Where are you off to?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...This place is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: It's gotten dark, but... the moon is really clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I murmur that the timing is perfect.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(The moon is so bright. Stars everywhere, too.
Even at night... I can clearly see the face of the person beside me.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Is this the place that suits this outfit?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Why did you choose this place?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was entirely expecting a place that was much more... well,
gloomy and oppressive...
choice_data_list: ? That's not how I pictured you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Like a light within the night...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is not a darkness where nothing can be seen.
Nor is it an anxiety-inducing silence.
choice_data_list: I couldn't convey it well the other day, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A light floating in the night—
like it's reassuring you, telling you not to be afraid.
...That's the kind of image it gives me."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: I was just thinking that the outfit itself looks like a cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......
...I am the light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Manhattan Cafe looking blankly at me,
I panicked, worried I hadn't explained it well again, and hastily added more words.
choice_data_list: A-Anyway, it means it's super relaxing!
I almost got completely entranced, or something...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Peaceful, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I meant to add a helpful detail,
but it ended up sounding terribly clumsy. Even so,
Manhattan Cafe smiled happily—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You've always welcomed me with such warmth.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (...Up until now, so many people have felt 'fear' toward me. They've called me creepy, and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: To me... you are the one...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm... entranced.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: Ah! No, wait, that's not... well, it is, but umm!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe seemed somewhat restless, perhaps feeling shy. Wrapped in an awkward atmosphere, she kept talking to gloss over it.
choice_data_list: A-Anyway, it looks great on you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...――
...Heheh, fufufu."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This was one of my favorite outfits as well, but... it's become even more special. And... fufu.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (...To think there's someone who likens me to light.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —I've grown even more fond of you.
